'''Sal Halak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[biochemist]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Residing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], Halak managed a small shop, also teaching the knowledge of biochemistry to others.
